title: Uruguayan Roasted Chicken with Garlic
description: Classic French-inspired roasted chicken dish with a Uruguayan twist and infused garlicky flavor.

ingredients.name: infused garlicky butter
ingredients.notes: see instructions for making infused garlicky butter

instructions: Rinse the chicken and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Make the infused garlicky butter by mixing softened butter with minced garlic and parsley.
Rub the infused garlicky butter all over the chicken, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Place the chicken in a roasting pan and drizzle with olive oil.
Pour in chicken broth and white wine (if using).
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 45-50 minutes, basting it with pan juices every 20 minutes.
Check the internal temperature of the chicken to ensure it reaches 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for 10-15 minutes before carving and serving.
